item.title: 1.2.0b1
item.description:
# Task12 1.2 beta 1
This is a test build. Thank you for trying it. Please send any feedback to whoever shared it with you.
- **A new look.** Task12 is now blocky and monochrome, with a light mode. Use the **Dark / Light** switch at the top of the side panel; Task12 remembers your choice. - **A bigger window on bigger screens.** Everything grows with the window, and the new slider above the images changes the tile size. - **A quality chart.** It shows the trade-offs of High, Balanced, Smallest and Manual at a glance. - **Smoother progress.** The rings and the new progress bar move evenly and never jump backwards. - **Settings (⌘,).** Appearance, processing speed, the launch notice, notifications, where files are saved, and the preset for new images. - **A notification when a batch finishes** while you're in another app, plus a progress bar on the Dock icon. - **Results count down** to the new total size.
